biggest_catch: Minimum $50,000 of new-to-Citi funds to earn anything at all, maintained through the funding deadline; must enroll through a Financial Advisor or the National Investor Center at 1-833-350-2258.
catches: Must enroll in the promotion by contacting a Financial Advisor or the National Investor Center at 1-833-350-2258; enrollment is not automatic.
Must enroll in or maintain eDelivery of statements through the Account Funding Period deadline.
New-to-Citi funds must be maintained in the account through the Maintain Funds deadline stated in the Terms and Conditions.
Offer expires September 30, 2026; Citi may change or cancel the offer at any time.
Investment and insurance products are NOT FDIC insured, NOT a bank deposit, NOT insured by any federal government agency, NO bank guarantee, MAY LOSE VALUE.
Not offered to individuals resident in the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Jersey, Guernsey, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican, or Isle of Man.
Bonus paid into an IRA account is treated as earnings; distributions reported on Form 1099-R; consult a tax advisor.

c1.evidence: Citigroup Inc. / Citibank N.A. — real global bank; terms in Citi's own Personal Wealth Management campaign document (tscs_cpwm_1q26.pdf) on Citi's snamwpm.eccmp.com campaign domain.

c2.evidence: Official Citi document: 'Promotion Name: 1Q 2026 Citi Personal Wealth Management Promotion' with tiered cash bonus for new-to-Citi funding: $500 at $50,000-$199,999 up to $5,000 at $2,000,000+; third-party confirmation the offer was extended through 9/30/2026.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to open; enrollment via advisor or National Investor Center at 1-833-350-2258. Minimum $50,000 new-to-Citi funding required to qualify (not a fee, but a large funding bar).

c4.evidence: Citi's official promotion terms spell out the tier table ($500/$1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$5,000 by funding band), enrollment requirement, eDelivery requirement, and maintain-funds deadline; bonus paid per the terms and conditions.

eligibility: Individuals with at least $50,000 in new-to-Citi funds willing to open or enroll an eligible Citi Personal Wealth Management account (IRA-eligible) and enroll in the promotion through a Financial Advisor or the National Investor Center before September 30, 2026. Not available to EU/EEA/Switzerland/Channel Islands residents.
notes: Distinct from the retail Citi checking/savings bonuses; this is the wealth-management tiered bonus. Catalog has no existing Citi route (dedupe-check for 'Citi Personal Wealth' returned 0 catalog hits, 0 evidence hits). Wealth management accounts carry investment risk — the bonus is real but the underlying account may lose value.
numeric_basis: payout from official Citi promotion terms (tiered $500-$5,000); time: advisor enrollment call + account opening + funding, est. 60-180 min active
payout_value_note: tiered cash bonus by new-to-Citi funding band

s1.note: Eligibility concrete: $50k+ new-to-Citi funds, new or existing eligible Citi Personal Wealth Management account, enrollment via advisor/National Investor Center.

s2.note: Requirements concrete: fund with new-to-Citi funds during promotional period, maintain enrollment in eDelivery through funding deadline, maintain funds through the maintain-funds deadline.

s3.note: Timing concrete: offer expires September 30, 2026; bonus paid per terms and conditions after qualification; maintain-funds deadline stated in terms.

s4.note: Tiers stated flatly by funding band; 'up to $5,000' is a stated banded structure, not weasel language.

s5.note: Terms hosted on Citi's own campaign domain (snamwpm.eccmp.com) as a Citi-branded Important Information Letter; third-party coverage matches the terms.

s6.note: No earnings promise beyond the conditional bonus; explicit NOT FDIC insured / may lose value disclosure; IRA tax treatment stated.

s7.note: Numbers consistent: 500/5000 USD tiered; 60-180 active minutes for enrollment, account opening, and funding.

steps: Contact your Citi Financial Advisor or call the National Investor Center at 1-833-350-2258 to enroll in the Personal Wealth Management promotion before September 30, 2026.
Open or identify an eligible Citi Personal Wealth Management account (IRA-eligible options available).
Fund the account with at least $50,000 in new-to-Citi funds during the promotional period (plan for a large transfer).
Enroll in or maintain eDelivery of statements through the Account Funding Period deadline.
Maintain the new-to-Citi funds in the account through the Maintain Funds deadline; the bonus is paid per the promotion terms.
timing: Enroll and fund before September 30, 2026; maintain new-to-Citi funds through the Maintain Funds deadline; bonus paid per promotion terms.
